I have verified the source thoroughly. Here are my findings.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerdict","claim":"The inject-mode result contract requires the agent's final line to match /^\\s*VERDICT:\\s*(pass|fail|partial)\\s*(?:[—–-]+\\s*(.*))?$/i; a missing marker returns verdict 'fail' with what_tried null","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:52-59"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerdict","claim":"The verdict is case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase; the what_tried text is optional and trimmed, defaulting to null","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:55-56"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseFindings","claim":"FINDINGS is an optional single-line JSON array on the line immediately before VERDICT; a missing or malformed line never fails the step, it only returns empty findings with an error reason","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:14-30"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseFindings","claim":"parseFindings scans lines bottom-up, keeps only object (non-array) items, and truncates to FINDINGS_MAX=20, reporting a truncation or dropped-item error string","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:13,24-27"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerify","claim":"A VERIFY command is declared by an optional /^VERIFY:\\s*(.+)$/m line in step.context, same shape as the RAG: convention, and is left in context verbatim","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:61-71"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#runVerify","claim":"runVerify executes the VERIFY command with shell:true (deliberate, trusted step-author input) and a 10-minute default timeout, returning ok/code and the last 500 chars of combined output","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:77-81"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#applyVerifyGate","claim":"The VERIFY gate only downgrades a claimed 'pass' to 'fail' when the command exits non-zero; it is a no-op when there is no VERIFY command or the claimed verdict was not 'pass'","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:88-97"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#inject gate","claim":"In inject mode the runner treats an errored run or a missing VERDICT marker as fail, then applies applyVerifyGate with cwd=process.cwd() before recording the attempt","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:331-338"}]

If you learned something DURABLE that a later step should know — a fact about the code or system, a decision, a lesson, a pitfall (NOT a log of what you did) — put it on ONE line immediately BEFORE the VERDICT line:
FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"path#symbol or config key","claim":"one atomic truth","evidence":"file:line or command"}]
kinds: fact | decision | lesson | failure | warning. Add "slot" for a single-valued setting (e.g. "port"). Report only what you verified; never invent evidence. Omit the line if there is nothing durable.
Report between 3 and 8 findings. Each must be something you verified in the code, with evidence.
The FINAL LINE of your output MUST be exactly:
VERDICT: pass|fail|partial — <one-line summary of what you investigated>
